# Cncf Paralus Reviewer

Review Paralus using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Paralus is a free, open source tool that enables controlled, audited access to Kubernetes infrastructure and Zero trust Kubernetes with zero friction.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
